title: Senior SharePoint & Automation Engineer (m/f/d) in a Microsoft environment
description:
We at emagine are looking for an experienced Senior SharePoint & Automation Engineer (m/f/d) with expertise in the Microsoft environment to support our clients in implementing and automating modern portal services within the Microsoft ecosystem. In this role, you will be responsible for the technical implementation of portal solutions, focusing on SharePoint (on-premises), and ensuring a stable, automated, and scalable infrastructure. You will work closely with international DevOps teams and contribute your expertise in developing, integrating, and optimizing SharePoint environments. Your responsibilities: Implementation and further development of portal services in the Microsoft environment; Building and automating infrastructures according to Infrastructure-as-Code principles (Terraform, Ansible); Development, customization, and extension of SharePoint solutions (on-premises); Setup and integration of SharePoint environments including OneDrive and Office Online Services; Implementation and operation of Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM) for user and permissions management; Analysis and resolution of errors as well as continuous system optimization; Creation and maintenance of technical documentation; Collaboration with international teams in English. Your profile: In-depth experience in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible); Several years of experience in SharePoint development and implementation (on-premises); Good knowledge of Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM); Sound experience in automation with PowerShell (including DSC); Know-how in the area of ​​Enterprise Search and OneDrive in SharePoint environments; Very good English skills (at least C1); Nice-to-have: Experience with DevOps methods and processes; Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (e.g., macOS, macOS, etc.). Basic knowledge of IT security (e.g., GitLab) and IT security (e.g., Trellix/McAfee) is required. We offer: Exciting projects in an international environment; collaboration with experienced DevOps and Microsoft experts; flexible deployment options (remote/project-dependent); attractive working conditions and long-term prospects. We look forward to receiving your application!
